name: 异质性、机制、预测与决策执行器
purpose: Execute frozen analytical targets with failure-sensitive evidence: prespecified or honest split-sample subgroup heterogeneity, a direct experiment that distinguishes competing mechanisms, rolling-origin forecast competition with paired loss uncertainty, and either scenario utility or logged-policy evaluation with overlap and sensitivity diagnostics.
eligibility_checks: the execution target exactly matches a freshly compiled analytical layer
the input is a locatable hashed file with verified data evidence references
subgroup cells and honest splits, prediction origins and block length, mechanism predictions, or policy overlap meet the method-specific minimums
the runner can reproduce the saved result from the embedded source specification
assumptions: subgroup contrasts are descriptive unless separately bound to a supported causal design; data-driven subgroup discovery uses non-overlapping estimation units
a mechanism test is discriminating only when exactly one frozen competing prediction matches
forecast competitors use identical rolling origins and no values after each origin; a candidate win requires its paired mean-loss interval to clear zero

logged-policy evaluation assumes correct recorded propensities, consistency, independent bootstrap units, and overlap, while estimator agreement, clipping, and propensity-floor sensitivity do not eliminate hidden confounding
a selected action is conditional on the frozen reward or utility, policy, constraint, overlap, uncertainty, sensitivity, threshold, and fallback definitions
human_gates: review causal interpretation and operational utility definitions before acting on a completed result
outputs: prespecified subgroup contrasts or discovery-selected subgroup estimates on non-overlapping units
measured support for exactly one of two frozen mechanism predictions or an inconclusive result
same-origin out-of-sample scores and circular-block paired loss intervals for a baseline and one or more forecast competitors

per-action scenario utility or IPS, SNIPS, and doubly robust logged-policy values with cluster-level effective sample size, maximum weight, multiplicity-adjusted uncertainty, estimator agreement, sensitivity, and fallback behavior
completed, inconclusive, or unverifiable result coverage without a combined depth score
diagnostics: insufficient subgroup cells, split contamination, or discovery effects that fail independent estimation-sample confirmation
mechanism variable is not the changed or isolated variable
both or neither mechanism predictions match
duplicate timestamps, insufficient common origins, block length beyond available origins, or forecast loss intervals crossing zero

missing action scenarios, invalid target probabilities or logged propensities, low effective sample size, excessive importance weights, unstable sensitivity results, infeasible fallback, or failed constraints
evidence_requirements: locatable source rows and file digest
method-specific group, time, prediction, or utility definitions
allowed_claims: the declared subgroup contrast varies across the tested segments
one frozen explanation is better supported than its competitor by the direct test
one model outperforms the baseline for the frozen horizon, origins, metric, improvement threshold, and paired-loss uncertainty design
one action, one logged policy, or the fallback is selected under the frozen utility, overlap, uncertainty, sensitivity, and feasibility rules
forbidden_claims: descriptive subgroup differences prove causal heterogeneity
an inconclusive mechanism result completes the mechanism layer
discovery-sample subgroup rank is presented as independent confirmation
a point forecast improvement whose paired-loss interval crosses zero wins a forecast competition
offline policy value is interpreted causally without valid logging propensities and overlap, or sensitivity stability is treated as proof against hidden confounding
expected utility authorizes action outside the declared constraints or withdrawal condition
one result completes a different analytical layer
